definitions: A military campaign of the First World War that took place on the Gallipoli peninsula in the Ottoman Empire between 1915 and 1916.
An unsuccessful attempt by the Allied Powers to control the sea route from Europe to Russia during World War I.
examples: The Dardanelles Campaign was a significant event in World War I.
Many lives were lost during the Dardanelles Campaign.
Winston Churchill was a proponent of the Dardanelles Campaign.
